name: Indra Putra Mahayuda
tagline: AI Engineer | Data Scientist | Computer Vision
about: AI Engineer and Data Scientist with 1 - 3 years of experience in machine learning, computer vision, and system optimization across industries including mining, autonomous vehicle and humanoid robotic. Skilled in building end-to-end AI solutions, from data analysis and model development to deployment, bridging technology with real-world business needs.

projects.title: Dynamic Dispatcher with Deep RL
projects.description: Built a deep reinforcement learning-based truck dispatcher system for mining production optimization, improving operational efficiency by 25% through real-time truck allocation and routing.

projects.title: Road Network Generator
projects.description: Developed a skeletonization algorithm to generate road networks from mining GPS unit data using computer vision and geospatial analysis, producing automatic road maps from vehicle tracking data.

projects.title: Fleet Management AI
projects.description: AI-based fleet management system for maintenance prediction and fuel consumption optimization, integrating IoT sensors with machine learning models for predictive analytics.

projects.title: Human Distance Detection Radar-Camera Fusion
projects.description: Developed a radar-camera fusion system for human distance detection, combining instance-segmented camera data with transformed radar coordinates to improve detection accuracy and reliability (100% object detection, 93.4% distance measurement accuracy).

projects.title: Object Detection and Localization for Humanoid Robots
projects.description: Developed a computer vision system for humanoid robots in the EEPIS Robot Soccer Competition, detecting the ball for interception and kicking, and landmarks for field position estimation. Achieved 1st place in 2021 and 3rd place in 2022.
